stories.title: CPSC Recall — Vevor Baby Swings Pose Suffocation Hazard (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Post 2A** — 9:00 AM MT (URGENT)
SAFETY RECALL: Vevor baby swings (models BB501K, BB702A, BB005K) recalled — suffocation hazard. About 1,020 units sold online in early 2025. Stop use now. Full refund available at vevor.com or call 855-599-6320.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

**Post 2B** — 12:00 PM MT
PSA for COS families: Vevor baby swings recalled due to suffocation hazard. Incline angle violates the Safe Sleep for Babies Act. If you have models BB501K, BB702A, or BB005K — stop use and request a refund. cpsc.gov/Recalls for details.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: Federal Recall: Stop Using Vevor Baby Swings Immediately — Suffocation Hazard Affects About 1,020 Units

stories.title: AAP 2026 Screen Time Guidelines — What Actually Changed (Tier 2)

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
**Post 4A** — 3:00 PM MT
The AAP retired the "2-hour daily limit" for screen time earlier this year. The new focus: quality and context over the clock.

No screens under 18 months. 1 hr of quality content for ages 2-5. Ages 6+: a Family Media Plan together.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: The AAP Changed Its Screen Time Guidelines in 2026. Here's What Actually Changed — and What Didn't.

stories.title: CPSC Recall — Liizousuda Paint Thinner Not Child-Safe (Tier 2)

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
**Post 5A** — 8:00 PM MT
CPSC recall: Liizousuda "Odorless Mineral Spirit" paint thinner (sold Amazon ~$10) lacks child-resistant packaging. Can cause chemical pneumonia if swallowed. If you have it at home, store safely or dispose. Details at cpsc.gov/Recalls.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: CPSC Recall: Liizousuda Paint Thinner Lacks Child-Resistant Packaging — Risk of Serious Lung Damage
